```text
Usage: libfossil repo submanifests <command>

Sub-manifest tree settings

Flags:
  -h, --help           Show context-sensitive help.
  -R, --repo=STRING    Path to repository file
  -v, --verbose        Verbose output

Commands:
  repo submanifests enable [flags]
    Write new check-ins as sub-manifest trees

  repo submanifests retune --k=INT
    Re-pin the partition parameter for later commits

  repo submanifests disable
    Write new check-ins as flat manifests again

  repo submanifests status
    Show the sub-manifest settings and whether trees exist
```
